name: V (Five)
source:
You play as Angel, a young man who used to be kept only for his blood as he tries to readjust to life in a strange city full of people who want to eat him. The world seems scary and foreign, but at least he's got a few bodyguards in the form of a strange group of people who call themselves The Enforcers.

Can you figure out how to love again? Can you teach these so-called monsters how to do the same? Maybe even in this city without love, something can be found...

[From [url=https://awfulrabbit.itch.io/v-five]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演Angel。一名年轻男子曾被囚禁起来，只为供人抽取血液；如今他正试着适应一座陌生城市的生活，这里到处都是想吃掉他的人。世界既可怕又陌生，不过至少有一群奇怪的人自称“The Enforcers”，担任他的保镖。

你能学会再次去爱吗？你能教会这些所谓的怪物也学会去爱吗？也许即使在这座没有爱的城市里，也能找到一些值得珍惜的东西……

[来源：[url=https://awfulrabbit.itch.io/v-five]Itch.io[/url]]
